tools.name: get_tax_brackets
tools.description: The federal income tax rate schedule for tax year 2027 (or 2026) from IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35: the seven brackets (10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35, 37 percent) for single, married filing jointly, married filing separately and head of household, or estates and trusts, with the tax at the bottom of each bracket

tools.name: get_standard_deduction
tools.description: The standard deduction for tax year 2027 (or 2026) for a filing status from IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35, with the additional amount for each filer who is 65 or older or blind, the dependent rule (greater of a floor or earned income plus a fixed amount), and the change from the other year.

tools.name: calculate_federal_income_tax
tools.description: Federal income tax for tax year 2027 (or 2026) on an income, using the IRS rate schedule: subtracts the standard or itemized deduction (with the age and blindness extra), applies the brackets, returns the bracket-by-bracket breakdown, marginal and average rate, optional long-term capital gains taxed

tools.name: get_tax_amounts
tools.description: Other 2027 inflation-adjusted tax amounts beside 2026 from IRS Rev.
